decisions.reason: As a newly launched carpet that fits the firm's interior accessories offer and project business, it is more likely to be kept unless the range is later streamlined for overlap.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet supports the brand's craftsmanship and fine-material positioning, so management would usually give it more time on the market despite its niche character.
This product is close to the established assortment and easy to integrate into full interior concepts, though similarity to other new low-pile carpets raises some rationalization risk.
A corner bench builds naturally on the firm's furniture portfolio for residential and hospitality interiors, making continuation more likely than withdrawal after only a short market period.
The carpet matches the firm's broad accessories range, but with several related rug launches in the same period it faces a somewhat higher chance of being culled if the collection is simplified.

A swivel shell chair line fits strongly with workplace, public and residential interiors and aligns with the firm's focus on flexible contemporary environments, so it is unlikely to be dropped quickly.
